items.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
items.description: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.

items.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
items.description: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.

items.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
items.description: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

items.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
items.description: The court has upheld the 2020 beating of the black music producer as an aggravated circumstance of racism.

items.title: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest
items.description: A mathematician at Anthropic says he used an AI to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis, though verification will take some time.

items.title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations
items.description: A judicial investigation was launched after a complaint was filed last year over "allegations of a sexual nature".

items.title: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
items.description: Russia launched one of its biggest air attacks yet as it rejected the prospect of security guarantees for Ukraine.

items.title: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032
items.description: Plans to shutter the troubled facility date back to 2019, when the city council first voted to close it but delays arose over where to place inmates.

items.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
items.description: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.

items.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
items.description: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.

items.title: Indian man sentenced to 19-plus years in plot to assassinate US-based Sikh separatist leader
items.description: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire, and conspiracy to commit money laundering in February.

items.title: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months
items.description: Police officials called for "greater efforts to prevent... violence" against women and children.
